title: The DD plugin running in this repository is an npm-pack snapshot: re-pack and update it after changing the code
body: Claude Code loads DD here as dd@dd-dev 0.9.0 (project scope) from ~/.claude/dd-dev-marketplace/dd, the extracted `npm pack` of this checkout, not from the working tree: an edit to src/, hooks/, skills/ or scripts/ changes nothing in the running hooks until the snapshot is refreshed. Refresh: `npm pack --pack-destination <tmp>`, extract the tarball over ~/.claude/dd-dev-marketplace/dd (`tar -xzf ... --strip-components=1`), `claude plugin update dd@dd-dev`, start a new session. A headless check: `claude -p "..." --output-format stream-json --verbose --include-hook-events`, DD's output is in `system` events of subtype hook_response. After 0.9.0 is published: `claude plugin uninstall dd@dd-dev --scope project`, `claude plugin marketplace remove dd-dev`, `claude plugin install dd@deltadictum --scope project`. Why: the GitHub marketplace serves main (0.8.6) until the release, and the raw checkout cannot be the plugin source (output/ is 559 MB); the pack is what users receive, so testing it also tests the published file set.
not_derivable: Nothing in the repository says which copy of the plugin Claude Code loads here; the marketplace lives outside git.

evidence.summary: Set up on 2026-10-15: claude plugin marketplace add ~/.claude/dd-dev-marketplace; claude plugin install dd@dd-dev --scope project; probe delivered two memories on a Read of package.json.

revisit_when.description: Once 0.9.0 is published and dd@deltadictum is installed again, archive this memory.

issues: archived_by_person: 0.9.0 published 2026-10-15; both projects load dd@deltadictum from the GitHub marketplace, the dd-dev snapshot is gone
